to.shell_command: l=/tmp/nps-keys.log; echo "$(date +%T) forward down" >>$l; /opt/homebrew/bin/nowplayingseek forward --hold --progressive >>$l 2>&1; echo "$(date +%T) forward exit $?" >>$l

to_after_key_up.shell_command: l=/tmp/nps-keys.log; echo "$(date +%T) forward up" >>$l; /opt/homebrew/bin/nowplayingseek release forward 2>>$l

to.shell_command: l=/tmp/nps-keys.log; echo "$(date +%T) backward down" >>$l; /opt/homebrew/bin/nowplayingseek backward --hold --progressive >>$l 2>&1; echo "$(date +%T) backward exit $?" >>$l

to_after_key_up.shell_command: l=/tmp/nps-keys.log; echo "$(date +%T) backward up" >>$l; /opt/homebrew/bin/nowplayingseek release backward 2>>$l
